title: Quality Engineer
description:
With our strong investment in research and development and our culture of continuous improvement, Hexcel is the industry leader in the manufacturing of advanced composite materials, including carbon fiber, woven reinforcements, resins, prepregs, honeycombs and engineered core. We invite you to join the Hexcel team at various manufacturing sites, sales offices and R&D centers around the globe. Become a part of the “strength within.”
Hexcel is currently seeking a
Quality Engineer
for our
Pottsville, PA, USA
location.
The selected individual will be responsible for but not limited to the following obligations:
Support maintenance of comprehensive quality system.
Lead and/or participate in activities associated with root cause investigation for product and process defects.
Ensure best practice of new product introduction and process validation.
Coordinate lab testing for verification and validation of raw materials.
Assist in tool design as needed for process inspections.
Perform standard quality engineering tasks with include but not limited to non-conforming material disposition, non-conforming cost/trend analysis, corrective/preventive action, customer/internal MRB, process improvements (includes scrap reduction), automation of systems, inspection criteria, specification and contract review, and communication to and training of personnel.
While operating in the boundaries of Lean Principles, lead, guide, and direct lean implementation and training initiatives, including 6S, TPM, Kaizen, Flow Manufacturing, JIT, Kanban, and Rapid Improvement Workshops.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, or Statistics, or related degree is required.
Minimum of two (2) years of related experience in production or quality or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier management, internal audits, and overall troubleshooting or problem-solving capabilities.
Strong leadership and able to work effectively with engineering, production personnel, and management.
Root cause investigation experience. Knowledge and/or use of six sigma methods and continuous improvement techniques preferred.
Good math and analytical skills including a working knowledge of statistical techniques (SPC, SQC, DOE).
Excellent written, verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to read drawings, interpret written procedures and instruction and ability to understand geometric dimensioning and tolerances (GD&T).
Knowledge of AS9100/ISO and NADCAP preferred.
Knowledge of using 3D Modeling Software, CATIA is preferred.
Eligible candidates must be a: U.S. citizen, U.S. national, person lawfully admitted for permanent residence, temporary resident under sections 210(a) or 245(A) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, person admitted in refugee status, or person granted asylum. Hexcel (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composites technology, a leading producer of carbon fiber, and the world leader in honeycomb manufacturing for the commercial aerospace industry.
Hexcel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected class.

title: Quality Systems Engineer
description:
Purpose of the Role
The role supports the development, implementation, and effectiveness of PFN’s Quality Management System (QMS). It also supports integration of the QMS with software platforms to share and manage content, enabling the capture of knowledge and quality metrics in a collaborative work environment. Where appropriate, content design drives corrective actions to deliver on quality objectives and goals.
Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities
QMS Continuous Improvement (SIP Leadership)
Responsible for continuous improvement of PFN’s QMS through leadership of Self Improvement Planning (SIP).
Outlines Internal Audit Plans against industry quality standards and best practices.
Creates and manages Corrective Action / Preventive Action (CAPA) plans with metrics to monitor progress against objectives.
Performs periodic reviews of CAPAs and Internal Audits to sustain efforts.
Assists with planning and execution of External Audits and related CAPAs as needed.
Calculates, updates, and monitors quality metrics.
Works with cross-functional departments to support system updates and implementation consistent with meeting quality goals.
Provides training to team members as required for implementing quality initiatives.
Vision System Leadership (Reliability Troubleshooting)
Serves as the Primary Vision System Leader for troubleshooting issues and providing guidance to the team responsible for system reliability.
Sets up new recipes and classifiers for new products.
Optimises recipes and classifiers as needed.
Checks inspection systems daily.
Sets up safety factors.
Calibrates and validates Vision System cameras.
Addresses MES issues.
Coordinates with OEMs as necessary.
Education And Experience Requirements
BS Degree in an Engineering, Technology, Mathematics, Business, or Science discipline.
5+ years in a technical role in a manufacturing environment is desirable.
Knowledgeable in the usage and setup of web-based applications and software packages.
Experience in Internal and External Auditing against quality standards (ISO, EDANA, and/or GMP).
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated technical, business, and leadership skills.
Knowledge of quality systems (ISO, EDANA, and/or GMP).
Skilled in statistics, problem solving, and procedure implementation.
Exceptional competence and professionalism in interactions with executive management, customers, and vendors.
Work Environment
Observes all safety rules and always uses proper safety equipment.
Physical Requirements
Manufacturing environment.
Must comply with all safety and PPE requirements, including but not limited to steel-toe shoes, safety glasses, and hearing protection.
Must be able to walk, talk, sit/stand, hear, reach, use a computer, climb stairs, and bend and twist throughout the day.

The above information on this job description has been described to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by incumbents. Other duties and responsibilities not specifically described may be assigned from time to time, consistent with knowledge, skills, and abilities of the incumbent.

title: Automation Engineer-onsite Williamsport, PA
description:
Automation Engineer
Williamsport, PA | Onsite Manufacturing
[Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.
With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.]
About The Role
As an
Automation Engineer
, you will play a critical role in designing, deploying, and sustaining advanced automation and robotic systems that enable
safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations
at Arxada’s Williamsport site. This role leads automation initiatives from concept through commissioning and long‑term reliability support, partnering closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, and Quality teams.
You will be empowered to
decide and drive automation improvements
, strengthen equipment reliability, and embed best practices that support cGMP and ISO requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced automation professional who thrives in a hands‑on manufacturing environment and is motivated to go beyond standard solutions.
Essential Job Functions
Design, implement, and improve automated manufacturing systems including PLCs, HMIs, robotics, and safety interlocks.
Define and maintain automation and control system architectures to maximize uptime, safety, and maintainability.
Develop, test, and deploy control logic, HMI interfaces, and automation scripts using structured testing and validation methods (FAT/SAT).
Lead commissioning and start‑up activities, coordinating cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth system handover and operator readiness.
Provide hands‑on troubleshooting, root‑cause analysis, and corrective actions to restore equipment and minimize downtime.
Establish and execute preventive and predictive maintenance strategies for automation assets, supporting long‑term reliability.
Create and maintain technical documentation including schematics, SOPs, code documentation, and change records to support audits and data integrity.
Train and coach operations and maintenance teams to improve first‑time‑fix rates and build automation capability on site.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Chemical, or related Engineering discipline.
5–10 years of experience working with industrial automation or control systems in a manufacturing environment.
Strong experience with PLCs (e.g., Rockwell CompactLogix / MicroLogix), HMI development, and robotic systems.
Demonstrated capability in commissioning, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support of automated systems.
Working knowledge of cGMP, ISO, and manufacturing safety requirements.
Strong collaboration, communication, and organizational skills in cross‑functional environments.
(To be included in US Postings Only)
The expected salary range for this role is 100-115k annually but specific employee compensation may vary depending on factors including experience, education, training, licensure, certification, location and other job‑related, non‑discriminatory factors permitted by law.
This role is also eligible to earn a short‑term incentive bonus and the following benefits: 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off, paid holidays and paid sick leave.
Arxada has world class offering in two distinct areas:
Microbial Control Solutions (MCS)
focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.
Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE),
meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high‑performance applications.
Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At Pittston Co-Packers, we are a team of hardworking individuals driven by a shared purpose: delivering the highest quality beverages through innovation, precision, and pride in our craft. title: Quality Assurance Coordinator -3rd Shift
description:
3rd Shift Quality Assurance Coordinator
Hours -12am-8am
The Quality Assurance Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring that all products produced in and shipped from our facilities are done so according to food safety and quality standards. They also ensure coordination and communication between the production and quality departments on their shift.
Duties And Responsibilities
Ensure & Monitor Production Quality:
Check Machines for correct product in bags
Check bag codes & labels
Check that correct cello is used
Check for correct BIP in bag
Ensure the correct bag weight
Inform production and warehouse management when products are out of compliance and take the necessary steps to make sure product is placed on HOLD for further evaluation.
Monitor & Audit Production Standards
Work with QA technicians on monitoring quality levels (for example, seasoning readings)
Monitor proper registration and seals on packaging.
Verify equipment setup is correct (seal checkers, seasoning programs, etc.)
Make sure metal detectors are working according to procedures
Audit & Control
Audit product samples
Ensure correct swabbing is done between Allergens
Ensure machines and lines are properly cleaned.
Communication & Training
Train employees on quality practices
Ensure employees understand product standards
Complete metal detector verifications with production operators
Communicate Quality Holds to production and Management
Ensure & Monitor
Ensure monthly swabbing is done on every machine
Inspect all production areas weekly for non-conformance & document findings
Carry out inspections to ensure food safety standards are maintained plant wide
Required Education/Experience/Specific-job-related Skills
Associate Degree in Food Science or Science related degree preferred
2 years working in food processing or quality control.
1 year of experience in food manufacturing preferred
Working knowledge of Food Safety Standards, HACCP, Kosher, and GMP.
Strong computer use / knowledge of Microsoft (Excel, Word)
Effective written, verbal and interpersonal skills
Physically be able to navigate throughout plant / industrial environment without impediment
About Wise
Wise Foods Inc. is a leading producer of salty snacks with a long heritage. Founded in 1921, Wise is a brand of tradition and authenticity that consumers have come to know and trust over the last 100 years. Since our inception, our iconic brand has symbolized great tasting snacks for many generations of consumers including potato chips; cheese flavored baked and fried corn snacks, tortilla chips, pretzels, popcorn, corn chips, onion rings and other assorted snacks. We market our products under some of the most recognizable brand names in the salty snack industry, including Wise, Cheez Doodles, New York Deli and Bravos. We also produce private label products for a number of retailers. Products are distributed using a direct-store-door ("DSD") delivery and merchandising system and sold in major grocery retailers, neighborhood markets and urban bodegas, as well as established retailers in the mass, convenience store, drug, food service and club channels. Wise Foods is fully owned by Arca Continental, the second largest Coca-Cola bottler in Latin America and one of the largest in the world. We invite you to explore growing your career with Wise!

title: QA/QC Inspector
description:
ModCorr offers rapid, efficient delivery and setup of minimum to maximum security correctional facilities and specialty units. All products are constructed offsite in a controlled environment and conform to the same building codes as traditional construction. ModCorr’s safe, secure and high-quality units comply with all American Correctional Association (ACA) and American with Disabilities Act (ADA) standards.
Position Summary
The QA/QC Inspector plays a critical role in ensuring that all prefabrication processes and products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and compliance. This position is responsible for inspecting raw materials, in-process work, and finished products to ensure they meet blueprints, technical specifications, and client requirements. The QA/QC Inspector supports continuous improvement efforts, identifies non-conformances, and collaborates with production teams to resolve quality issues and maintain compliance with industry standards, including ISO requirements.
This position reports directly to the Director of QA/QC (or designated supervisor) and works closely with production, engineering, and project teams.
Key Responsibilities
Inspection & Testing
Perform visual, dimensional, and functional inspections of raw materials, subassemblies, and finished products.
Verify conformity to specifications, blueprints, and industry standards.
Utilize precision measurement tools such as calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and other inspection instruments.
Documentation & Reporting
Maintain accurate and detailed inspection records, including logs of non-conformances.
Prepare and distribute inspection reports to supervisors, engineers, and management.
Communicate quality issues clearly and promptly to relevant stakeholders.
Quality System Compliance
Ensure adherence to ISO standards, company quality policies, and customer requirements.
Participate in internal and external quality audits.
Support the enforcement of quality procedures throughout fabrication and assembly processes.
Problem Solving & Corrective Action
Collaborate with production and engineering teams to determine root causes of defects.
Recommend and support corrective actions to eliminate quality issues.
Provide feedback to help improve manufacturing and inspection processes.
Continuous Improvement
Contribute to the development and refinement of quality control procedures.
Suggest and implement improvements to enhance efficiency, safety, and product quality.
Knowledge and Skills Required
High school diploma or GED required. Additional certifications or training in quality control or inspection preferred.
2+ years of experience in quality inspection within a fabrication or manufacturing environment.
Experience with metal fabrication processes and tolerances preferred.
Proficient in reading and interpreting blueprints, specifications, and technical drawings.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify defects and deviations.
Proficiency with precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges).
Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Computer literacy, including Microsoft Word and Excel.
Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality standards preferred.
Welding experience and/or SPC (Statistical Process Control) knowledge a plus.
Work Environment
The QA/QC Inspector will primarily work in a fabrication shop setting with exposure to machinery, equipment, noise, and potential hazards. The role also includes office-based tasks for documentation and reporting. Safety is critical, and all company safety procedures must be followed, including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).

title: Quality Engineering Technician- 2nd Shift
description:
**Join a Team That Makes a Difference!**
At Noble, the work you do matters. We manufacture innovative products that support the military, advance the medical field, and improve everyday life. Whether it's enhancing safety, enabling critical care, or solving real-world challenges, our solutions help people when it matters most. Be part of a purpose-driven team where your skills contribute to meaningful change.
**Noble Biomaterials, Inc is currently seeking a Quality Engineering Technician on our 2nd shift (2pm-10pm). The Quality Engineering Technician (QA Technician) is a hands-on, manufacturing-focused quality role that provides real-time support to daily production operations. This position is embedded on the production floor and partners closely with Fabric Operations, Process Engineering, and Production to reinforce quality procedures, support inspection and disposition decisions, and ensure accurate and compliant documentation. This role is critical to supporting the expansion to two-shift fabric manufacturing and serves as the primary quality presence on the production floor during second shift. This is not a laboratory role-the focus is on manufacturing execution, quality discipline, and operational decision-making.**
What You'll Do
Serve as the primary Quality Assurance representative on the production floor during second shift.
Support fabric inspection activities, including visual inspections, in-process checks, and disposition decisions in accordance with approved procedures and specifications.
Partner with the Fabric Quality Engineer, QE Manager, Operations, and Process Engineering on day-to-day quality decisions.
Reinforce adherence to approved work instructions, control plans, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Monitor quality performance trends and assist with root cause analysis and failure investigations.
Utilize quality tools (InfinityQS, JMP, Decision Logs) to analyze performance trends and document deviations.
#### Documentation & Good Documentation Practices (GDP)
Ensure accurate, complete, and timely completion of batch records, travelers, inspection records, and manufacturing documentation in compliance with GDP requirements.
Review documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance prior to escalation or release.
Verify that process documentation reflects current manufacturing practices and escalate discrepancies as needed.
#### Operational & Cross-Functional Support
Support Operations and Process Engineering with real-time issue identification, containment actions, and production floor feedback.
Assist with the implementation and reinforcement of approved process changes and procedural updates.
Act as a quality liaison between shifts to ensure continuity of communication, issues, and corrective actions.
#### Continuous Improvement & Compliance
Identify quality risks, recurring issues, and gaps in procedural adherence; escalate appropriately.
Support internal audits, inspections, and quality initiatives.
Promote a strong quality culture through visibility, clear communication, and consistent expectations.
#### Additional Responsibilities
Perform other related duties as assigned by Quality or Operations management.
The Skills You'll Need
Basic computer skills required (Microsoft Office, electronic forms, data entry).
Familiarity with manufacturing documentation systems, GDP, and ISO 9001 concepts is a plus.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify procedural or documentation discrepancies.
Ability to make practical, well-reasoned decisions within established quality frameworks.
Comfortable working on the manufacturing floor for extended periods.
Able to follow procedures precisely while recognizing when escalation is required.
Self-motivated and capable of working independently during off-shift hours.
Quick learne with the ability to absorb technical and procedural information.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
Effective communicator across Quality, Operations, and Engineering teams.
What We're Looking For
High school diploma or GED required.
Previous experience in a manufacturing or quality environment strongly preferred.
Experience as a production lead, senior operator, or quality technician is highly desirable.
Quality control experience preferred; laboratory experience is not required and is not the focus of this role.
**Ability to train 12pm-8pm until training is completed**
What You'll Get
**Starting Pay: $18.00-$22.00/hour based on experience**

title: IVA and Digital Platform Developer
description:
A Day in the Life of the IVA and Digital Platform Developer:
Design and Development: Lead the end-to-end development of Interactive Virtual Assistant (IVA) Digital/chat solutions, including intent recognition, entity extraction, dialogue flow management, API Connections and sophisticated response generation, specifically focusing on building robust Conversational AI experiences.
Platform Expertise: Leverage and master IVA/Digital development platforms (e.g., Kore.ai, Google Dialogflow, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Bot Framework) to build, configure, train, and deploy high-performing conversational agents. Platforms are not limited to what is outlined.
System Integration: Integrate IVA/Digital seamlessly with API Connections to various backend systems, utilizing REST and SOAP Web Services for robust functionality, efficient data exchange, and a unified user experience across different platforms.
Natural Language Understanding (NLU) & Generation (NLG): Implement, fine-tune, and optimize NLU models to improve intent accuracy, entity recognition, and overall comprehension. Develop effective and natural-sounding NLG templates and strategies for engaging responses, potentially leveraging Small Language Models (SLMs) for specialized tasks.
Data Handling: Work with data formats like JSON and integrate with databases such as SQL / Oracle / Redis / MongoDB for efficient data storage and retrieval.
Development and organization of data, technology information and/or metrics to be delivered to audiences, including but not limited to upper management, team members, and vendor partners
UAT/QA Testing & Quality Assurance: Conduct rigorous testing, debugging, and performance tuning of IVA/Digital applications across various scenarios and channels. Identify and resolve complex issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement: Analyze conversation logs, user interactions, and feedback data to identify patterns, pain points, and opportunities for improvement. Proactively refine dialogue flows, add new intents, and enhance IVA capabilities based on data-driven insights.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with product managers to translate business requirements into technical specifications and contribute to the product roadmap for our Conversational AI initiatives. Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure intuitive and user-friendly conversational interfaces. Work with data scientists to leverage advanced AI/ML models.
Research & Innovation: Stay up to date on the latest advancements, trends, and best practices in Conversational AI, NLP, machine learning, and related emerging technologies, including the application of SLMs and other innovative models. Research and recommend the adoption of new tools and techniques where beneficial to our IVA/Digital solutions.

title: Manufacturing Quality Technician
description:
Lesjofors Springs America (LSA), a leader in the manufacture of Industrial Power Springs, has an immediate opening for a hands-on
Manufacturing Quality Technician
to support its quickly growing medical segment at its Pittston, PA location.
Successful candidates for this position will:
Inspection/test materials, products, and equipment to ensure they meet demanding quality standards for supply into the medical device industry.
Record data from quality control tests and prepare reports on findings.
Work closely with the production team to identify and correct quality issues efficiently, prevent scrap, and ensure 100% quality delivered to our customers.
Develop and implement quality control procedures, including inspection checklists and testing protocols for the medical production segment.
Perform routine audits of manufacturing processes and procedures to identify potential quality improvements.
Provide training and support to production personnel on quality control processes and procedures.
Collaborate with other departments such as engineering and supply chain to ensure quality standards are met throughout the production process.
Program and operate measurement and testing equipment to assess product dimensions, tolerances, and performance.
Maintain a safe and clean work environment, following company policies and procedures.
Continuously improve knowledge and skills through training and education to stay abreast of industry trends and best practices.
Successful candidates for this position will possess the following
Bachelor’s degree with experience in a quality department of a manufacturing environment,
Or High school diploma or equivalent, with 5+ years of experience in the quality department of a manufacturing environment.
ISO 9001 knowledge and experience required / ISO 13485 preferred.
Ability to read/write simple instructions and communicate effectively with team members.
Ability to lift up to 40 lbs. periodically throughout the day.
Ability to study and analyze data through SPC.
Ability to work closely with engineers and production personnel to resolve problems.
Effective communication and strong computer skills.
A self-starter to prioritize tasks, follow instruction and work with minimal supervision.
A strong team player able to perform well in a total quality environment.
Ability to travel (5%) for training, external audits or other quality improvement activities.

The Annual salary is $55-75K USD per year.
PTO up to 5 weeks annually.
401k plan with enhanced employer contributions.
Short-Term and Long-Term Disability benefits.
Eleven paid holidays per year.
Annual bonus opportunity.

Highly competitive base pay.
Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs.
Group retirement savings program.
Health and wellness programs.
An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion.

title: Quality Lead
description:

Division: Nucor Towers & Structures Inc
Location: West_Hazleton , PA , United States
Other Available Locations: Pennsylvania
Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.

Basic Job Functions:
The Quality Lead responsibilities include but are not limited to, overseeing all aspects of quality, including fit and function, along with documentation compliance. Serves as the facility's Leadership Representative on his/her respective shift. Assisting team members with interpreting shop drawings, QMS requirements, and customer specifications, including obtaining clarification from other functions to ensure that quality requirements are understood and met. Help execute the overall quality strategy to meet the Design of Steel Transmission Pole Structures (ASCE48), the American Welding Society D1.1 requirements, and Nucor Towers and Structures objectives.
Support the implementation of quality management systems, best practices, and processes
Contain, evaluate, and disposition nonconforming products; investigate the root cause of nonconformances.
Assist team members with completing any certifications necessary to perform their duties.
Train the team on quality requirements, procedures, testing, and usage of measuring tools
Identify potential areas of risk and make recommendations for solutions.
Identify process improvement initiatives and help execute projects to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC)
Work with the plant team on root cause analysis and corrective action resolutions. Perform inspection and testing duties as required by customer specifications and other requirements that provide acceptance criteria for NTS products.
Other duties as assigned by the Quality Supervisor.
Minimum Requirements:
Associate's degree with at least 3 years of quality control/Non-Destructive Testing experience, OR
At least 5 years of quality control experience in a manufacturing/fabrication facility.
5+ years of experience with AISC or ISO quality systems.
Ability to interpret codes and standards, shop drawings, and customer specifications.
Highly adaptable, able to quickly adjust to shifting priorities in a dynamic work environment while maintaining a positive attitude and a proactive approach to getting things done promptly.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
Ability to work independently and make informed, rational, data-driven decisions with minimal supervision.
Preferred Qualifications:
BS in Leadership or Business Administration
NDT Level II in Ultrasonic Shear wave, Magnetic Particle and Visual Testing
AWS Certified Welding Inspector
Extensive knowledge of AWS D1.1 code
